name: ExamWorks
desc:
Application Support Specialist | $28.85 - $31.25/hr | Full-Time, Remote, Support and troubleshooting, no sales expected
ExamWorks
Industry: Information Technology

What a typical day will look like:
You are the go-to person when staff and clients have trouble with the company's software. You will look into reported issues, figure out what went wrong, and fix it or hand it to the right team. You will work with the Service Desk, programmers, and business teams. Some days you will test new software releases, write step-by-step guides so users can help themselves, and help set up systems like enterprise fax, transcription, and dictation. You will also help move newly acquired companies onto the ExamWorks platform.

Soft Skills
- Problem solving
- Clear written and verbal communication
- Attention to detail
- Patience with frustrated users
- Teamwork and keeping information confidential
assessment: Yes, expect an assessment after applying or after initial contact with recruiter
skills:
Actual Minimum Requirements

Education Minimum: Not listed. Bachelor degree in a related field is preferred.
Required Experience: Extensive knowledge of the MS Windows platform. Must be able to keep information confidential and follow company policies.
Preferred Experience: 3+ years in application support (or an equal mix of education and experience). Insurance or healthcare industry experience.

Required Skills: Troubleshooting, testing and documenting software issues, writing user instructions, working with developers and end users.

This role is ideal for someone who:
- Already has help desk, IT support, or application support experience
- Knows Windows well and likes solving technical puzzles
- Explains technical things in plain words
- Wants a steady, full-time remote role with a team

Not a Good Fit for someone who:
- Has no IT or support experience yet
- Is not comfortable with Windows and business software
- Wants a role with no troubleshooting or documentation
- Cannot work standard business hours, Monday to Friday
notes:
Expected Application & Interviewing Process:
1. Submit application
2. Expect an assessment email
3. Watch for email inviting to a prescreening
4. Depending on how well the prescreening went, expect an email to schedule an interview
This is an estimated process.

Top 10 resume keywords:
- Application support
- Technical support
- Troubleshooting
- Microsoft Windows
- Help desk or Service Desk
- Software testing
- User documentation
- Issue resolution
- Healthcare or insurance systems
- Cross-team communication

4-5 Interview Questions for this Role:
- Walk me through how you troubleshoot a software problem you have never seen before.
- How do you explain a technical fix to someone who is not comfortable with computers?
- Tell me about a time you found the root cause of a problem that kept coming back. (PAR: Problem, Action, Result)
- Tell me about a time you worked with a team to solve an issue for a frustrated customer or coworker. (PAR: Problem, Action, Result)
- How do you keep your documentation clear and up to date?
other:
Pay, Shift, Benefits, Background, Drug Test Information, and Career Pathway:

-Pay: $28.85 - $31.25/hr

-Shift: Monday to Friday, standard business hours, preferably EST or CST

-Benefits: Medical, vision, dental, paid time off, and 401k

-Equipment Provided: Not listed in the posting

-Felony Friendly? Case by case

-Drug Test: Certain positions

-Notes: 100% remote with no travel. The posting asks for 3+ years of application support experience, so this fits participants with IT or help desk experience best.

-Career Pathway: Reasonable inferred path: Application Support Specialist → Systems Analyst → IT Project Coordinator → IT Manager.
